artworks.title: Clothes Exchange, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene. The image captures a busy street flanked by buildings on both sides. The street is bustling with activity, with various figures depicted in the foreground and midground. There are simple line drawings of animals walking along the street. The details are rendered in delicate and sketchy lines. The top right includes some signage.

artworks.title: Clothes Exchange, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior space reminiscent of a busy station or industrial building. The viewpoint is at eye level, showing structured arches, arched windows, and a grid-like pattern. The horizon is not visible due to architectural elements and people. The illustration style is sketch-like with loose brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia and cream tones. Figures are scattered, showing movement and daily life, with minimal detail. The building's features in the background add depth.

artworks.title: Fleur de Lys Passage
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an exhibition entrance featuring an alleyway leading to an archway with a sign reading "ENTRANCE TO THE EXIBITION. CLOTHES EXCHANGE." The sketchy lines outline structures and figures, including a hanging lantern. The scene indicates a busy marketplace with multiple figures suggesting movement and activity. The sketch style depicts a moment in time.

artworks.title: Saint James's Place, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene captured from a slightly elevated perspective, offering a wide view of the area. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the image, meeting the edges of the buildings. Atop one structure, the word "M. & E. Ceux." is visible. The image features fine and delicate brushstrokes with a sketched quality. The line work effectively conveys figures and architectural forms. The color palette is limited to beige and brown tones, typical of aged ink or paper. Several figures are suggested with light brushwork in the foreground, while denser lines are used for stores and facades in the distance.

artworks.title: Cutler Street, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene viewed from a slight elevation. Buildings line the street, and people are visible at various distances. To the left, there is a shaded area with a sign reading "ABRAHAMS." The technique used is etching, creating a sketch-like quality with light strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with brown tones.

artworks.title: Melon-Shop, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with multiple figures inside a room and two seated individuals outside beneath a window. The people inside are facing forward, appearing to be behind a counter or desk with various items around them. Their facial features are somewhat indistinct and they have short, roughly styled hair. The figures outside are seated side by side, showing upper body details and similar facial features with simple, tidy hairstyles. They wear clothing that suggests turn-of-the-century fashion. There is no jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background is rendered with a textured, cross-hatched style, depicting shelves and creating a sense of depth in the enclosed environment.

artworks.title: After the Sale, Hounsditch
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several figures. In the center, there is a woman standing with hands on hips. She is wearing a long dress with long sleeves and an apron, with a scarf or head covering. To her right are an adult and two children sitting on a lower level or bench. The adult and children are minimally detailed, with facial features highlighting nose and mouth outlines and short hair. Their clothing is loosely sketched. In the background, there is an abstract representation of a room with rough, expressive lines. The setting appears to be an interior space against a textured background.

artworks.title: Steps, Gray's Inn
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a park scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high up, with small figures on a path or promenade. Closer to the viewer, there are seated figures, including adults and children. The etching features sparse lines and a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic, with the lines in a dark hue. Elements in the middle and distance, such as trees and figures, are depicted with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Long Seats, Gray's Inn
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The point of view in this image is at eye-level. The horizon line is not clearly defined but seems to be indicated by the line of figures seated on a bench towards the left half of the image. The brushstrokes are in a delicate, light sketching style with fine lines used to define the contours and details of the figures. The color palette is monochromatic, with light beige paper and dark-toned lines. The image depicts a group of people including women and children, some seated and others standing, with gentle details suggesting their attire and interactions. In the background, subtle outlines suggest additional figures. Some minimal detailing hints at architectural or natural elements.

artworks.title: The Little Nurse
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with a composed expression, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a layered dress. Two children are also depicted next to her, wearing similar hats and dresses. The background is blank, and there are no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Church Doorway, Edgemere
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a doorway. The image shows a sketch of an arched entranceway with minimalistic line work. The doorway features an arch supported by straight columns with light shading to suggest some stonework detail. Above the door, there is a rough indication of a window or architectural element. Sparse markings hint at additional texture or objects to the side of the door. The style is succinct, giving the essence of the structure without overwhelming detail.

artworks.title: The Cock and the Pump
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street in a village scene with buildings and people. The perspective is at street level, capturing a row of buildings with pitched roofs. The horizon is not distinct, and the scene is rendered in an etching style with sketch-like brushstrokes indicating the buildings and clouds. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of beige and black. Figures, possibly women and children, are conversing near a rooster, adding to the lively atmosphere. More figures are seen along the street, and additional buildings are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Ramparts, Sandwich
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image contains an outdoor scene with people situated on a gently sloping landscape. The point of view is slightly elevated, offering a broad view. A windmill is visible on the horizon to the right. The sketching technique shows fine line work capturing the lightness of the scene. The color palette is monochrome. Figures are seen sitting on the grass, with others standing and holding an umbrella. Detailed lines depict foliage, grassy textures, and scattered trees across the landscape.

artworks.title: Charing Cross Railway-Bridge
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a bridge featuring multiple arches in the center. In the foreground, there is a lone bare tree with figures underneath it. The illustration is done in fine lines and cross-hatching in a monochrome palette of beige or light sepia.

artworks.title: Wild West, Buffalo Bill
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is moderately high, suggesting an open space. The brushstrokes are delicate and minimalist, creating an impressionistic style. The palette is monochromatic, with shades of beige and brown. Figures are lightly sketched close to us, suggesting movement. More figures and structures are visible in the distance, hinting at a leisurely outdoor event.

artworks.title: Tilbury
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a harbor scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene includes water, docks, buildings, ship masts, boats with figures, larger anchored ships, and distant structures. The lines are sketchy and light, with minimal detailing. The color palette is mainly beige and dark ink. The background features swirls and cloud-like shapes.

artworks.title: Monitors
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of boats and ships on the water with a low horizon line. The composition features sketch-like etching lines with a monochromatic color palette of earthy tones. The scene conveys a sense of openness, with a focus on suggestion rather than detailed precision.

artworks.title: Dry-Dock, Southampton
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a low vantage point, with the water's edge closest to us forming the bottom of the composition. In the distance, the horizon line is occupied by an arrangement of simple structures, possibly buildings along a waterfront, with a prominent ship to the right. The brushstrokes and etching lines are delicate and detailed, sketching out forms with a light touch. The color palette consists of a muted, sepia tone on aged paper. The sky above is lightly sketched with sparse cloud details, providing a subtle balance between the water and the horizon line.

artworks.title: Dipping the Flag
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a harbor scene with ships in the distance. The horizon is positioned towards the top third of the image and shows the water in between. The drawing style includes fine lines and minimal strokes to depict the sails and masts intricately. The color palette is limited to natural tones of paper and dark ink, creating a detailed visual impact. Closest to the viewer is a partial view of a ship's prow, indicating a nearby boat, contrasting with the distant ships on the horizon. The image conveys a sense of calmness and openness in the water, with subtle line work suggesting gentle ripples.

artworks.title: Ryde Pier
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a group of people in an outdoor setting. In the top center, four figures, possibly women, are chatting while seated under a canopy or tent. To the right, another person is seated and appears to be holding an object. The figures wear dresses and hats. The background depicts a waterfront with faint outlines of masts in the distance, hinting at boats or ships. The sketch is done in light, airy lines on a simple background.

artworks.title: Windsor, No. 2
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch-like view looking at a distant complex of buildings and a tower from a slightly elevated perspective. The architectural structures sit atop a hill and appear lightly sketched, possibly resembling an old castle or fortification with a flag on the tallest tower. The brushstroke style consists of fine lines with minimal shading, capturing the architecture and surrounding foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with muted tones typical of pencil or ink on paper. The reflections of the structures are seen on the water's surface, indicated by vertical lines and gentle curves. Beyond the water, the building outlines become more intricate against a sky with sparse, light cloud formations represented by soft lines.

artworks.title: The Fur Cloak
artworks.medium: drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length sketch of a person standing. The individual is shown facing forward with their body slightly angled to the side. The face has subtle features, eyes, and a faint hint of a mouth, framed by short hair or a cap. The person is clad in a long garment, potentially a coat or robe, with sketched textures indicating folds and shadows. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the individual. The background features abstract, cross-hatched pencil strokes, adding a textured effect around the figure, with no detailed scenery or context.

artworks.title: Nora Quinn
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on a stool or chair. The person is shown in a side profile, facing forward. They have short hair under a hat with a brim. The individual is wearing long, flowing clothing. The sketch has minimal facial features but highlights a soft gaze. The background is simplistic and lacks detail, with some textured lines.

artworks.title: Miss Lenoir
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person from the waist up. The subject is facing forward with their hands near their chest. The person's facial features are lightly sketched, and their hair is styled up under a hat or headpiece with textured or feather-like details. They wear a detailed, ruffled collar or a fur-like garment around their neck and shoulders. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background is plain and unadorned.
